English.question: ১) We were waiting <u>for the bus</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp:
Phrase টি wait verb-কে modify করায় এটি adverbial phrase. অপশনে adverbial phrase থাকায়, উত্তর কোন ভাবেই prepositional phrase হবে না।
এই প্রশ্নটি ২৮ তম বিসিএস পরীক্ষায় এসেছিল এবং অপশনে সঠিক উত্তর adverbial phrase ছিল না। তাই কাছাকাছি উত্তর হিসেবে সেখানে prepositional phrase কে সঠিক উত্তর হিসেবে ধরা হয়েছে।

English.question: ২) ‘A best seller’ means-
English.option3: গ) a seller who is best
English.option4: ঘ) a book that sells in very large number
English.exp: A best seller- a book or other product that sells in very large numbers. 'Her autobiography is an international bestseller'

English.question: ৩) <u>What you think</u> is reflected in your actions.  The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Noun Clause বাক্যে একটি subject বা একটি object-এর স্থানে noun হিসেবে কাজ করে। এখানে subject-এর স্থানে আছে।

English.question: ৪) Well, he’s not that all. He is a bird brain. Here, ‘a bird brain’ means-
English.exp: A bird brain (নির্বোধ লোক)- a silly or stupid person.

English.question: ৫) <u>Although Jim was very ill</u>, he worked very hard. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: যে subordinate clause একটি বাক্যে একটি adverb হিসেবে কাজ করে এবং একটি verb,বা একটি adjective-clause বা অন্য একটি adverbial clause-কে modify করে তাকে Adverbial Clause বলে। এখানে , Contrast বোঝানো হচ্ছে।

English.question: ৬) ‘Acid test’ means-
English.exp: Acid test: a conclusive test of the success or value of something, the true test of the value of something.

English.question: ৭) Jack is not willing to watch this movie <u>because he doesn’t like the hero</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: যে subordinate clause একটি বাক্যে একটি adverb হিসেবে কাজ করে এবং একটি verb,বা একটি adjective-clause বা অন্য একটি adverbial clause-কে modify করে তাকে Adverbial Clause বলে। এখানে , Cause and effect বোঝানো হচ্ছে।

English.question: ৮) À la mode means-
English.option2: খ) according to the current fashion
English.exp: À la mode: in fashion; up to date. 'corduroy is extremely à la mode this season'

English.question: ৯) Aric has lost the pen <u>which John gifted him on his birthday</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: যে subordinate clause বাক্যে একটি adjective হিসেবে কাজ করে এবং noun বা pronoun-কে modify করে তাকে Adjective Clause বলে। এখানে, “which John gifted him on his birthday” noun, the pen-কে modify করছে।

English.question: ১০) ‘Buoyant health’ means-
English.exp: Buoyant health- good health, excellent health.

English.question: ১১) I had been watching the movie <u>before you came</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: যে subordinate clause একটি বাক্যে একটি adverb হিসেবে কাজ করে এবং একটি verb,বা একটি adjective-clause বা অন্য একটি adverbial clause-কে modify করে তাকে Adverbial Clause বলে। এখানে, “before you came” movie দেখার time নির্দেশ করছে।

English.question: ১২) Gift of the gab means-
English.exp: If someone has the gift of the gab, they are able to speak easily and confidently, and to persuade people.

English.question: ১৩) Do you know <u>why he left</u>? The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Noun Clause বাক্যে একটি subject বা একটি object-এর স্থানে noun হিসেবে কাজ করে। এখানে object-এর স্থানে আছে।

English.question: ১৪) ‘Harp on’ means-
English.option1: ক) to play on the flute
English.option4: ঘ) talk about the same subject
English.exp: Harp on (about sth): to talk or complain about something many times. (Cambridge Dictionary)

English.question: ১৫) She cannot remember <u>what she said last night</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: The clause acts like a noun. It could be replaced with a noun, e.g., her rant.

English.question: ১৬) You should try to <u>make good</u> your loss. The underlined phrase means-
English.exp: If you make good some damage, a loss, or a debt, you try to repair the damage, replace what has been lost, or repay the debt.

English.question: ১৭) You should never make fun of something <u>that a person can't change about themselves</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: This clause could be replaced with an adjective, e.g., unchangeable.

English.question: ১৮) <u>Where there are too many soldiers</u>, there is no peace. <u>Where there are too many lawyers</u>, there is no justice. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Adverbial Clauses of Place

English.question: ১৯) He visits this place <u>every now and then</u> The underlined phrase means-
English.exp: every now and again (or now and then): from time to time; occasionally. 'I used to see him every now and then'

English.question: ২০) You can <u>if you think you can</u>. You're right <u>if you think you can't</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Adverbial Clauses of Condition

English.question: ২১) ‘Riding for a fall’ means-
English.exp: Riding for a fall: to be behaving in a way that is likely to lead you into trouble.

English.question: ২২) Now I know <u>why tigers eat their young</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: This clause could be replaced with a noun, e.g., the reason.

English.question: ২৩) ‘Status quo’ means-
English.exp: Status quo (noun): the existing state of affairs, especially regarding social or political issues. 'they have a vested interest in maintaining the status quo'

English.question: ২৪) My friend <u>who lives in London</u> looks like Homer Simpson. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: The clause acts like an adjective. It could be replaced with an adjective, e.g., my London-based friend.

English.question: ২৫) He has supported the team for over ten years through _________ .
English.exp: If you support or stay with someone through thick and thin, you always support or stay with them, even if there are problems or difficulties.

English.question: ২৬) Say nothing <u>when you win</u>. Say less <u>when you lose</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Adverbial Clauses of Time.

English.question: ২৭) Complex sentence consists of ________ .
English.exp: Complex sentence consists of two clauses. They are dependent & independent clauses.

English.question: ২৮) She had pretty hair and must have been nice-looking <u>when she was young</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Subordinate (or dependent) clauses cannot form sentences on their own. They are dependent on main clauses to form sentences.

English.question: ২৯) She didn't know <u>where she was</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: A noun clause is a group of words that band together and act like a noun. Nouns clauses are used when a single word isn't enough. They're always dependent clauses; they cannot stand alone as a complete sentence.

English.question: ৩০) Without working hard, you can’t pass the BCS Preliminary Exam. (Complex)
English.option1: ক) Though you do not work hard, you can’t pass the BCS Preliminary Exam.
English.option2: খ) With working hard, you can pass the BCS Preliminary Exam.
English.option3: গ) If you do not work hard, you can’t pass the BCS Preliminary Exam.
English.option4: ঘ) With the following smartest idea, you can pass the BCS Preliminary Exam.
English.exp: Without + gerund থাকলে If do not/ does not বা unless বসে। Verb এর ing যুক্ত form মূল verb এ রূপান্তরিত হয়।

English.question: ৩১) I keep a suitcase packed, <u>in case I find a great flight to Ireland</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Adverb clauses are groups of words that function like an adverb. They modify verbs, other adverbs, or adjectives. These clauses are typically used to elaborate when, where, why, how, how much, or under what condition the action of the sentence took place.

English.question: ৩২) They are so poor that they cannot buy food. (Simple)
English.option1: ক) They are poor to buy food.
English.option2: খ) They are poor for buying food.
English.option3: গ) They are too poor to buy food.
English.option4: ঘ) They are poor enough to buy food.
English.exp: so …… that থাকলে too …… to হয়।

English.question: ৩৩) Money <u>that is well spent</u> will last forever. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Adjective clauses are groups of words that modify nouns and pronouns.

English.question: ৩৪) Though he tried hard, he failed. (Compound)
English.option2: খ) In Spite of his trying hard, he failed.
English.option3: গ) He tried hard, but failed.
English.option4: ঘ) But for his trying hard, he failed.
English.exp: Though/although থাকলে দুটি clause এর মাঝে but বা yet বসে।

English.question: ৩৫) <u>He studied violin and mathematics</u> before taking a medical degree and doing postgraduate work in biophysics at Harvard. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp: Main (or independent) clauses can form sentences on their own. They aren’t dependent on other clauses. They are always finite (they must contain a verb which shows tense).

English.question: ৩৬) Victoria rode the brown horse. (passive)
English.option1: ক) The brown horse had been ridden by Victoria.
English.option2: খ) The brown horse had been rode by Victoria.
English.option3: গ) The brown horse was ridden by Victoria.
English.option4: ঘ) The brown horse was ride by Victoria.
English.exp: Active voice কে Passive voice- এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম: Active Voice এর object‌ টি Passive voice এর subject হয় + Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb + মূল verb এর past participle + Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এর object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to,in) বসে।

English.question: ৩৭) I’ll take the train and <u>you can take the car</u>. The underlined part is a/an-
English.exp:
We can combine clauses of the same grammatical type to form sentences using coordinating conjunctions:
[main clause]I’ll take the train and [main clause]you can take the car.

English.question: ৩৮) Fire burnt the ship. (Passive)
English.option1: ক) The ship was burnt by fire
English.option3: গ) The ship was burnt with fire.
English.option4: ঘ) The ship was burnt to fire.
English.exp: Active voice এ যদি subject হিসেবে people, one, someone, somebody, fire ইত্যাদি থাকে, তাহলে passive করার সময় তাদেরকে by সহ লেখা হয় না।

English.question: ৩৯) He is <u>in the library</u>. The underlined part is-
English.exp: ‘in the library’ phrase টি verb কে অর্থপূর্ণ করতে সাহায্য করেছে এবং একই সাথে অবস্থান প্রকাশ করায় এটি adverbial adjunct.

English.question: ৪০) Raju’s work pleased me. (Passive)
English.option1: ক) I was pleased by Raju’s work.
English.option2: খ) I was pleased with Raju’s work.
English.option3: গ) We were pleased by Raju’s work.
English.option4: ঘ) Raju’s work was pleased by me.
English.exp: Pleased এর পর preposition হিসেবে with বসে।

English.question: ৪১) He is as handsome as a hero. (Comparative)
English.option1: ক) He is handsome than a hero.
English.option2: খ) A hero is more handsome than him.
English.option3: গ) A hero is not as handsome as him.
English.option4: ঘ) A hero is not more handsome than him.
English.exp: অর্থ ঠিক রাখতে নেতিবাচক বাক্য হবে। আর handsome এর comparative form হলো more handsome.

English.question: ৪২) I know where he lives. The sentence is a _______ sentence.
English.exp: দুটি clause relative pronoun দ্বারা যুক্ত থাকলে সেই sentence কে complex sentence বলে। তাই ‘where’ relative pronoun দ্বারা যুক্ত sentence টি complex sentence.

English.question: ৪৩) Choose the right sentence.
English.option1: ক) He is senior than me for five years.
English.option2: খ) He is senior to me for five years.
English.option3: গ) He is five years older to me.
English.option4: ঘ) He is senior from me for five years.
English.exp: Latin Comparative (senior, junior, major, minor) এর পরে to বসে। যেমন, He is senior to me for five years.

English.question: ৪৪) When I was reading a book, he came. It is a ________ sentence.
English.exp: প্রদত্ত বাক্যে ‘When I was reading a book’ একটি sub-ordinate clause থাকায় বাক্যটি Complex Sentence .

English.question: ৪৫) This novel is one of the ______ of this author.
English.exp: বাক্যটি superlative degree এর হওয়ায় উত্তর হবে worst. Bad এর comparative form ‘worse’ এবং এর superlative form ‘worst’.

English.question: ৪৬) He is so weak that he cannot walk. (Simple)
English.option1: ক) He is so weak that walk
English.option2: খ) He is weak to walk
English.option3: গ) He is too weak to walk
English.option4: ঘ) He is very weak to walk
English.exp:
Complex sentence: so ….. that
Simple sentence: too …… to .

English.question: ৪৭) ‘En route’ means-
English.exp: ‘En route’ একটি ফরাসি শব্দ যার অর্থ ‘On the way’ অর্থাৎ পথিমধ্যে।

English.question: ৪৮) The South Pole is too cold for human beings to live in. It is a ______ sentence.
English.exp: Simple sentence এ একটি মাত্র সমাপিকা ক্রিয়া থাকে।

English.question: ৪৯) The idiom ‘a snake in the grass’ means-
English.exp: A snake in the grass অর্থ লুকানো শত্রু অর্থাৎ a hidden enemy .

English.question: ৫০) ‘Feel at home’ means-
English.exp: Feel at home অর্থ স্বাচ্ছন্দ, আরাম বা তৃপ্তি অনুভব করা।
